details.direction: Haitang Yanyu Park, out-and-back below Chaotianmen Bridge, back past the park, Yangtze River Bridge, Meidiyacheng, Lijiatuo Bridge, out-and-back at Ronghui Jiangshan, then Lijiatuo Bridge, Meidiyacheng, Yangtze River Bridge and back to Haitang Yanyu Park.
